title: Three Septembers and One Short Hand
subtitle: 离别送别 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 离别送别（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·良好的人际关系与人际交往）
meta: 主题语境：离别送别（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·良好的人际关系与人际交往）　|　核心词汇：goodbye　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 goodbye 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the stationmaster ① said a goodbye that no passenger on the platform would have described, and he said the saying was the whole of the September. The ② goodbye, meaning the word itself and not the wave, ran three Septembers and stayed undescribed in the book; a goodbye, he said, is the only thing on a platform that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ goodbye on that platform had the same short hand beside it, and the ④ goodbye at the far gate, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A goodbye, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the stationmaster said the describing is the part that fills three Septembers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the goodbye was the whole of the matter, meaning the leaving and not the word. The ⑥ goodbye, meaning the leaving and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; goodbye, he said, is either something you say or the only word that means both a word and a leaving. He said the leaving is the part they remember.

By 1978 the ⑦ goodbye had become a line in a letter, and the letter had become an argument about the short hand. The ⑧ goodbye of the whole thing, the stationmaster wrote in November, was one platform and three Septembers of describing; goodbye, he said, is either the one at the far gate or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ goodbye I remember is the one described in the letter, which closed in 1980 and is still described as the quietest on the platform. A ⑩ goodbye, my mother said in 1982, is the only one that improves by being described; every goodbye, she said, is a leaving that has agreed to look like a word. She said the leaving was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 告别（指站台上每一次旁边的那一次）
B. n. 告别（指那句话本身，与挥手相对）
C. 固定搭配：say a goodbye 道一声别
D. n. 告别（指留给孩子们学的那一次）
E. n. 告别（抽象总称，指一处站台的送别之事）
F. n. 告别（指信里写到、被记下的那一次）
G. n. 离别；分别（指一件事里人人都怕却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 离别（抽象总称，指人人都怕却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: said a goodbye that no passenger on the platform would have described

answers.why: say a goodbye 意为“道一声别”，1972 年那位站长道了站台上没有一位旅客肯描述的一次别。
goodbye 意为“告别”，指那句话本身而不是挥手，它经过了三个九月而在簿子上没有被描述。
goodbye 意为“告别”，指站台上每一次旁边的那一次，每一次旁边都有同一只矮矮的手。
goodbye 意为“告别”，指最远那道门口留给孩子们学的那一次，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
goodbye 意为“离别、分别”，指一件事里人人都怕却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这次离别就是那件事的全部。
goodbye 意为“离别”，指人人都怕却无人提起的那样东西而不是那句告别，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
goodbye 意为“告别”，指信里写到、被记下的那一次，到 1978 年这一次成了信里的一行。
goodbye 意为“告别”，站长十一月写道，整件事的送别之事是一处站台和三个九月的描述。
goodbye 意为“告别”，我记得的是信里描述过的那一次，1980 年过去了，至今仍被说成站台上最安静的一次。
goodbye 为抽象总称，母亲 1982 年说，一次告别是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的东西。
